content: Never use uncertain language like 'I believe' or 'approximately' when a customer demands a specific price; always provide a confirmed number or escalate to a manager immediately.
When a customer repeats a question, it signals that the previous answer was insufficient. Do not repeat the same reframe; instead, provide new information or a concrete action.
Use the customer's own test results as evidence to build credibility and reduce skepticism.
For price-sensitive customers, break down cost per year or per use to justify the investment.
Always have pre-approved discount figures and bundle details ready to avoid delays in closing.

name: Cost-Per-Year Reframe
condition: When customer objects to upfront price, especially for durable goods.
example: Instead of focusing on the price tag, calculate the cost per year of use. For a tablet expected to last 3 years, divide the price by 3 and compare to daily coffee expenses.

name: Customer Evidence Anchoring
condition: When customer has tested or used a similar product, or has personal experience.
example: Reference the customer's own test results: 'You just saw it run 3 apps smoothly — that's proof of performance. Now imagine that for the next 3 years.'

name: Manager Escalation for Certainty
condition: When customer demands a firm price or discount that the salesperson cannot confirm.
example: Immediately offer to check with a manager: 'Let me get my manager to confirm the exact price and discount. 60 seconds, and I'll have a written quote for you.'

rebuttal_template: I understand 12 triệu is your limit. Let me show you the exact price right now: the MatePad 12X with student discount is [exact price]₫, which is under your budget. And here's the proof: [show a printed price list or screen]. Plus, with the included M-Pencil, you save an additional [value]₫. Shall we proceed?

Absolutely. I've just confirmed with my manager: the price is locked at [exact price]₫ for the pre-order. I'll write it on this form and stamp it. If the price drops later, you get the lower price. That's our guarantee.

objection: I need to show my brother before signing.
rebuttal_template: Of course. Let me print the pre-order form with all details: price, M-Pencil included, warranty covering battery. You can take a photo and send it to your brother right now. While you wait, let me show you the actual device so you can see how smooth it runs — that will help convince him too.
